posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Another 3 games via G+, another great day for the Sentinels... except for that 1 loss against Dawn.

 

Our first was against Voss, it was possibly the longest game of Sentinels I've played. Pike Industrial Complex changed all the damage to toxic and we went into a holding pattern, nearly all of Voss' minions were under Savage Mana, the only ones left out were immune to toxic damage and Legacy was immune to the toxic damage that the minions were dealing out. It was just a matter of time before the Omnicannon and Savage Mana built up a large enough charge to take out a 70+ HP Voss!

 

Then we played against Mad Bomber Baron Blade, he went down far quicker than Voss, the only thing I really remember about it was that Ra took out Blade's first side with a Wrathful Gaze!

 

Dawn was last up and kicked our arses all over the shop. Absolute Zero could not find a Isothermic Transducer to save his life (literally) and he succumbed to a combination of fire damage from the minions and a Kraken. Unity went down next, also to the Kraken but her bots had done some decent damage to Dawn and her Citizens, enough to get her to flip (with a 3 player game she flipped back very quickly though). Alone, Mr Fixer was holding his own out there with a Pipe Wrench/Driving Mantis Combo that was redirecting all kinds of damage around (including a useful Toxic Seaweed!) but when Devastating Aurora came out... nothing could save him.

So we all now live under Dawn's benevolent rule, all hail Citizen Dawn!

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Oh my golly gee, that Voss game felt like it would never end. I thought for sure Legacy was going to get knocked out, as her health had dropped as low as 2 health at one point. All in all it was still a splendid game and totally awesome how that much damage was able to be pulled out all in the last round. It still annoys me that I drew motivational charge at the end of the game.

 

That Dawn battle was awesome, even though we lost. For the pure fact that Mr. Fixer dealt 30+ damage to Dawn after the other two heroes were incapacitated. Sadly a well timed Devastating Aurora will disrupt any hero.

 

Speaking of games online! I also just set up another one. Starting at 9 central time, I believe that would be 3 GMT.

posts.name: Garou
posts.cooked:
Brutal evening for the heroes - we got three games in. First one, the Matriarch had a rather tame start in Insula Primalis, playing two Darken the Skies that did absolutely nothing. Everything went downhill from there, fast. The third Darken brought out eleven fowl with everyone at low HP (except for the Matriarch, who was almost full) - we called the game after that.

Second game didn't go much better: Wraith, Zero and Expatriette faced off against the Chairman in Pike Industrial. The less said about it the better, but we did manage to bring the Operative down by 12 HP before everyone faceplanted.

The final game made up for a lot of the pain that came before: Tachyon, Mr. Fixer and Expatriette versus The Ennead in Rook City. The Villains weren't too threatening at first, but Rook City did what Rook City tends to do (and Falling Statuary managed to miss the villains two out of three times) and the pain kept coming fast. In the end, a Toxic Sludge managed to actually work in the heroe's favor, bringing everyone low with only Isis surviving at 2 HP. The final villain card played was The Grave Beckons (destroy non-villain targets with <= 3HP), which killed of Tachyon and Expatriette, but allowed Fixer to finish off Isis for the win.

Once more a very enjoyable experience, thanks to Matchstickman, Ronway and Mezike!

Well just finished the two great games. First up was against the powerful Plague Rat, using RC Wraith, F6 Tempest, and Ra in Insula Primalis. Finally a online game where we actually beat him. Tempest spent the game healing and keeping the infections under wraps, while Wraith and Ra beat Plague Rat to death.

 

Next up Evan dropped out of the battle, but Garou and I took the control of two heroes each. Wraith, Unity, Bunker, and Argent Adept facing GloomWeaver in Megalopolis. He didn't really stand a chance. Most of his minions weren't out for more than one round, and those who survived that turn were dispatched with on the next round. As Garou pointed out though it was a good thing we didn't play on advance mode as the only real problem with that would of been the time it would take Unity get more golems out and Argent Adept to get set in full offensive mode.

edit: Well, Apostate looked like he was about to kick us into another dimension with eight relics coming out in the first two turns. Eternal Haka, Young Legacy, Fixer, and Tachyon were on the ropes with barely a scratch on the villain, when Haka's card drawing frenzy saved the day by bringing a rampage into hand. A few well timed Grease Guns, Ground Pounds, and Hypersonic Assaults kept the bogeyman at bay long enough for us to recharge through healing and to start whittling away at Apostates HP. We were in the Realm of Discord, which hadn't been altogether kind to us, when Time Flies came out and was immediately our best friend. A heavy take down with a 13 pt Haka of Battle + Taiaha combo was enough for Legacy to finish the job. Great game, and a totally unexpected turnaround from a dire situation!
